Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2990; true (as not concealing):--true, truly, truth.
BiblicalUsage: True, as not concealing — and John leans on the word harder than anyone. Jesus says His record is true even though He bears witness of Himself, because He knows where He came from and where He goes. The law needs two witnesses, and His witness and the Father's agree. Paul tells the Philippians to think on whatsoever things are true, and John says the anointing teaches all things and is truth, and is no lie.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe truth is not an idea first but a person, and that is why John keeps saying it of Jesus. What is true is what does not hide, and Christ hides nothing — He came from the Father in the open and goes back to Him in the open. I hold that thinking on what is true is not positive thinking; it is fixing the mind on the One who is true, and letting everything false fall away.
